title: Models Input
description: Input schema for custom models, providers, and model packs

models.description: Custom models to import into Gpt4cli. They can be referenced by 'modelId' in model packs.

providers.description: Custom model providers to import into Gpt4cli. They can be referenced in a custom model's 'providers' array.

modelPacks.description: Model packs to import into Gpt4cli. These define which models to use for each of Gpt4cli's roles.
